title: Turbo Tire
subtitle: A fast arcade destruction game where you drive a giant tire through a city, chaining boosts, ramps, and jumps to smash props and rack up score.
overview: Turbo Tire is an arcade-style score attack experience where the player controls a tire rolling through a city and causing as much destruction as possible. The core loop is built around movement momentum and spectacle: using boosters, ramps, and big jumps to crash into objects like billboards, poles, and other breakable props while maintaining speed and building points. The focus is on satisfying feedback, strong sense of velocity, and readable visual effects during fast traversal.
role: I worked on the project’s visual side: creating untextured 3D models (props and environment pieces), building VFX for object destruction, and implementing a speed-focused visual layer. I set up a speed vignette, an outline shader for readability, god rays, and post-processing to push the overall look. I also created additional VFX elements to support impact feedback and reinforce the game’s fast, chaotic feel.
description: An arcade city-destruction prototype where you drive a tire, hit boosters and ramps, and smash props to score points.
timelineCaptions: Early pass: prop modeling (untextured) and initial visual targets for a stylized city-destruction feel.
Mid pass: destruction VFX implementation and speed feedback (vignette, impact visuals) iteration.
Final pass: outline shader, god rays, post-processing polish, and visual consistency tuning.
